meaning: You are told you won a contest or lottery. To collect, you must pay a fee or share private details.
clues: It begins with surprising news about money or something you can get.
You are told you won a contest you never entered.
To get your winnings, you must first pay a fee or share private details.
Real contests do not make you pay to collect a prize.
It has two words. The first has five letters and starts with P.
assumes: A fake check scam sends you a check that later turns out to be fake
A tech support scam starts with a fake computer problem

decoys.meaning: Someone sends you a check and asks you to send part of the money back. The check turns out to be fake.
Someone says your computer has a problem. Then they ask for money or access to fix it.
A crook pretends to be a loving partner online. After gaining trust, they ask for money.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: You cannot win a contest you never entered. If someone says you must pay to collect a prize, hang up.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Back in my day, the only prize I got was a gold star. Nobody charged me a fee for it.
